title: Search replicas lose access to catalog endpoints
summary: Search requests from one replica pool fail before a catalog response, while neighboring pools continue to return results.
precursor: The search deployment was expanded into a second availability zone during the latest catalog index release.
impact: Shoppers in the affected region cannot reliably find listed products, reducing discovery and increasing repeated searches.

title: Login requests cannot reach directory listeners
summary: Login attempts routed from a subset of API pods fail immediately, while existing session refreshes continue to complete.
precursor: The identity directory service endpoints and the session API client were updated in separate steps during a scheduled rollout.
impact: New sign-ins fail for affected users, preventing access to account and checkout workflows and driving authentication retries.

title: Tracking detail calls exceed the dependency budget
summary: Tracking detail requests intermittently return an unavailable response after waiting on a dependency, while cached shipment summaries remain responsive.
precursor: Carrier tracking traffic increased after a marketplace integration began polling more frequently for in-transit orders.
impact: Customers see delayed delivery updates, and support teams receive more requests to confirm shipment status manually.

title: Live pricing previews return dependency errors
summary: Live price preview requests receive intermittent upstream errors, although saved price lists and product pages remain available.
precursor: A catalog publication increased live evaluation traffic shortly after a new pricing ruleset became active.
impact: Merchants cannot verify some price changes before publication, delaying catalog updates and creating inconsistent promotion timing.

title: Reservation calls return responses the caller cannot use
summary: Reservation requests complete at the transport level but a portion of responses are rejected by the caller, while stock reads continue to succeed.
precursor: The inventory API and checkout client were rolled out in the same release window, with their replicas replaced over several minutes.
impact: Some checkouts cannot secure stock and must be retried, increasing cart abandonment and the risk of duplicate reservation attempts.
